description: A geotechnical research group built on deep research, strong connections and future impact.

pillars.title: Deep research
pillars.text: Laboratory testing, numerical modelling and field monitoring, brought together to understand how ground behaves.

pillars.title: Strong connections
pillars.text: Students, faculty, industry partners and research groups working as one network.

pillars.title: Future impact
pillars.text: Results that carry into design, construction and long-term monitoring of real infrastructure.

join.title: For students
join.text: Join a team that tests, models and measures real ground. Tell us what you would like to work on.

join.title: For partners
join.text: Collaborate on field problems, share data or support research. We are open to new projects.
